title: Private Market Buying Trips
summary: A guided path through Dallas Market for those who would rather make confident decisions than spend days searching.
body:
Begin with a conversation about your space, your vision and the decisions you need to make. We can discuss a tailored showroom approach, potential product categories and how selections will connect to the broader design.

Trip format, market access, fees, dates and availability are confirmed individually. This is an inquiry-only offering, not a scheduled public event.

title: Showroom & Sourcing Strategy
summary: A considered sourcing brief before you buy. Define the pieces, finishes and relationships that matter most.
body:
We work through your goals, style direction, priorities and decision list. The resulting conversation can shape your approach to showrooms, furnishings, lighting and finishing pieces.

Contact the studio to discuss the scope and whether a guided market session is the right fit.

title: Selection & Procurement Planning
audience: Clients managing a furnished home or project
summary: Bring choices into focus after the inspiration: selections, priorities and a clear plan for what comes next.
body:
Once favorites are identified, we can help discuss the next stage of selections and project coordination, including priorities, budgets and lead-time questions to address with vendors.

Purchasing, trade terms and logistics depend on the agreed scope and are confirmed before engagement.

title: Small-Group Market Experiences
summary: A more personal way to explore industry sourcing alongside other design-minded people.
body:
Interested in joining a future buying or learning experience? Tell us about your work and the experience you're looking for.

No specific dates, group sizes, itineraries or registration fees are currently confirmed on this preview.

title: Interior Design & Home Staging Education
summary: Learn the design decisions that make spaces appealing, livable and ready for their next chapter.
body:
Foundational and advanced learning focused on interiors, spatial presentation and contemporary staging practices. Explore how to shape visual priorities, communicate a design direction and translate an idea into a finished space.

Workshop schedules, curriculum depth and delivery format will be confirmed directly with the studio.

title: Business Growth & Strategy
summary: Move beyond the mood board: sharpen pricing, positioning, client acquisition and business direction.
body:
Work through practical questions about positioning a creative service, packaging your offer, building client relationships and making deliberate growth decisions.

This page is an inquiry preview; class dates, instructor availability and fees are not yet published.

title: Events & Workshop Development
summary: Design engaging events and education experiences that feel intentional and support a stronger business.
body:
Explore the elements behind planning an audience-focused workshop or branded experience, from the initial idea to the flow of the day and the invitation to participate.

Formats are discussed individually; no future dates are confirmed here.

title: Real Estate & Airbnb Optimization
summary: Understand how styling decisions and guest-ready spaces contribute to better property presentation.
body:
Training explores the practical decisions behind preparing properties for sale or short-term stays, from visual presentation to guest experience and operating priorities.

Training availability and scope are confirmed after an inquiry.
